t: A small open-source synthesizer board with ten audio, MIDI, and CV jacks.
steps: Buy the AMYboard from Makerfabs for about 30 US dollars.
Get a USB-C cable and a pair of headphones or speakers.
Plug the board into your computer with the USB-C cable.
Open the AMYboard getting started guide on GitHub and update the firmware first.
Open the browser editor and run the first MicroPython example to play a note.
Load a Juno-6 or DX7 patch and play it from a MIDI keyboard.
Add encoders or a small screen through the Grove port next.
